summary: Frontend-only retest of the mold-color propagation bug fix (TagSheet -> ViewerPage/ObjectsPage handleSaved). All 6 scenarios in the review request PASS. The fix is correct: TagSheet.handleSave now enriches the onSaved payload with the selected mold's tipo/color/ancho/alto (looked up from the local molds catalog), so ViewerPage.handleSaved posts a setTag command to the iframe with the correct color hex, and ObjectsPage.handleSaved updates the row's color dot immediately.

test_evidence.bulk_tagging_regression: Etiquetado masivo modal opens with intact structure (bulk-tag-modal, mold-picker, bulk-notas-input, bulk-tag-apply-button) -- not affected by this fix

critical_code_review_comments: TagSheet.handleSave looks up the mold from the local `molds` state fetched at mount; if a brand-new mold is created via MoldPicker inline creation, MoldPicker must also push it into the parent `molds` state (via onMoldsChange) before the user clicks Guardar, otherwise the enrichment lookup returns null and the viewer will not paint the piece until reload. Worth a quick verification of MoldPicker's onMoldsChange callback timing on inline-create.
ViewerPage.handleSaved only sends {molde, color}. If in the future you want highlight/emissive to also reflect tipo or other mold attributes, extend the tagData payload accordingly.

Minor: setTag on delete is only fired when TagSheet's `onSaved` is called with molde=null; verify that closing the sheet without saving does NOT accidentally trigger a stale onSaved -- currently code path is clean (onSaved only called from handleSave and handleDeleteTag).
seed_data_creation: Used existing molds M-01 (#007AFF) and M-02 (#e10e0e). Test piece 'C1 C1 [6420986]' was mutated during tests but final cleanup left it in 'Sin molde' state (via delete tag flow).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fix verified end-to-end. Test approach: injected a postMessage interceptor on iframe.contentWindow to capture the __viewerCmd setTag/applyTags payloads emitted by ViewerPage.sendCmd, then asserted args[1].color matches the expected mold's hex (M-01=#007AFF, M-02=#e10e0e). This is a reliable pattern for the 3D viewer since window-scoped globals (tags, meshesByName) are not exposed on contentWindow due to `let` scoping in viewer.html. Reusable snippet in previous test scripts. Also validated persistence by hooking applyTags after a hard reload.
rca of the issue: PRE-FIX ROOT CAUSE: TagSheet.handleSave built `payload = {object_name, molde, notas, photo}` (only fields the /api/tags PUT accepts) and then called `onSaved({...obj, ...payload})`. Because `payload` did not contain `color_molde`, the merged object still carried the STALE `obj.color_molde` from BEFORE the edit (null for a piece that had never been tagged). ViewerPage.handleSaved then executed `sendCmd('setTag', [name, obj.molde ? {molde, color: obj.color_molde} : null])`, so the iframe received color=null and the material fell back to base color. FIX: TagSheet.handleSave now does `const mold = molds.find(m => m.name === molde)` and merges `tipo/color_molde/ancho/alto` from that mold into the onSaved payload. Similarly handleDeleteTag nulls all four fields. ObjectsPage.handleSaved now also copies tipo/color_molde onto the list row so the dot updates immediately. VERIFIED: post-fix setTag postMessage carries {color:'#e10e0e'} for M-02 and {color:'#007AFF'} for M-01.
